eswatini.title: Flag of the Kingdom of Eswatini

colors.note: Top and bottom bands symbolising peace and stability.
Narrow bands framing the central red, standing for the country's mineral resources.
Broad central band evoking past battles for the nation.
Elements of the central shield representing the ox-hide Nguni warrior shield.
Elements of the shield and staff feathers symbolising the monarchy.

desc:
- Blue bands at top and bottom, a broad red band in the middle separated by narrow yellow stripes
- A large Nguni warrior shield flanked by two assegais and a fighting staff is centred on the red
- The decorated staff is adorned with tassels made from widowbird and lourie feathers worn by the king
trivia:
- Based on a military banner given to the Emasotsha Regiment by King Sobhuza II in 1941
- The lidlabe shield is half black and half white to symbolise racial harmony
- The country was known as Swaziland until King Mswati III renamed it Eswatini in 2018
